episode_title: Lucky #888 — My Tour of Designing Luck in China, Japan, and Korea

real_qa.q: Why did Sichuan Airlines pay 2.33 million yuan for the phone number 8888-8888?
real_qa.r: In 2003, Sichuan Airlines paid 2.33 million yuan, approximately 280,000 US dollars at the time, for the phone number 8888-8888 to use as a customer hotline. The airline explained that the number is easy to remember and would make customers happy because the number eight is considered lucky in Chinese culture, as the sound resembles the word for prosperity and wealth.

real_qa.q: What was the license plate registration mark 88 price at the Hong Kong government auction in February 2025?
real_qa.r: In February 2025, the registration mark 88 sold at a Hong Kong government auction for 11.4 million Hong Kong dollars, roughly 1.5 million US dollars, reflecting the extreme premium placed on numbers associated with good fortune in East Asian markets.
real_qa.requete: Hong Kong license plate 88 auction February 2025 price

real_qa.q: When did Beijing hold the Olympic opening ceremony and how many marriages were registered that day?
real_qa.r: The Beijing Olympics opening ceremony started at 8 p.m. on August 8th, 2008, chosen to maximize the auspicious number eight. On that same date, Beijing registered 15,646 marriages, demonstrating the cultural belief in lucky numbers and timing.
real_qa.requete: Beijing Olympics August 8 2008 opening ceremony marriages registered

real_qa.q: How much premium did apartments on floors ending in eight command in Chengdu from 2004 to 2006?
real_qa.r: Economists studied apartment sales in Chengdu from 2004 to 2006 and found that apartments on floors ending in eight resold at a premium of about 7 percent. In the new apartment market where pricing was uniform, those lucky floors did not cost more but sold about a week faster.

real_qa.q: Why did Toyota change its family name from Toyoda to Toyota in katakana?
real_qa.r: The founding family's name was Toyoda, but the company became Toyota because in katakana, Toyota is written with eight strokes. Since eight strokes are associated with wealth and good fortune in Japanese culture, the company changed its name to embody this auspicious number.
real_qa.requete: Toyota name change Toyoda eight strokes katakana

real_qa.q: How many Buddhist temples are included in the Shikoku pilgrimage in Japan?
real_qa.r: The Shikoku pilgrimage is a circuit of 88 Buddhist temples associated with Kukai, also known as Kobo Daishi, reflecting the cultural significance of the number eight in Japanese Buddhist tradition.
